name: Lust Monster Girls
source:
Lust Monster Girls is an adult fantasy visual novel set in a world where humans, demons, and monsters live in harmony.

You play as the grandson of the Dark Lord, who enrolls in an academy and helps monster girls discover their desires through unusual sexology lessons.

Build relationships, uncover the heroines’ secrets, make meaningful choices, and stand against those who seek to destroy the peace between races.

[From [url=https://electrozinhu.itch.io/distortium]Itch.io[/url]]
